_about: Services & Pricing content for the ASBO site and, later, ASBO's knowledge base. Edit text and prices here; services.js builds the panel from this file. bestDraft: true marks a 'Best for' line Olga has not approved yet; it is not shown on the site until set to false.
intro: Websites built once, for a fixed price. Care plans if you want them. Every price is on this page.

packages.name: One-Page Website
packages.short: One custom-designed page with up to 5 sections, ready on every screen.
packages.best: A new or small business that needs one clear, professional page to send people to.
included: One custom-designed page with up to 5 sections
Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts
Contact form and social media links
excluded: Booking systems, CRM integrations, or databases
packages.limits: The 30-day warranty covers defects in the agreed development work, not new features or third-party issues.

packages.name: Business Website
packages.short: Up to 5 pages, custom-designed, with galleries, maps and analytics.
packages.best: An established local business that needs room for services, a gallery, an about page and contact.
included: Custom design tailored to the business
Galleries, portfolio sections, or service pages
Contact form with basic spam protection
Social media and Google Maps integration where applicable
excluded: CMS unless included in the proposal
packages.limits: A CMS is only included when the proposal says so. The 30-day warranty covers defects in the agreed work, not new features or third-party issues.

packages.name: Custom Website
packages.short: For businesses requiring more advanced functionality.
packages.best: A business that needs a blog or CMS, booking or CRM connections, or functionality built for its own process.
packages.limits: These are possible features, not a promise that every feature is included in the starting price. The final scope, deliverables, timeline, revision rounds, and fixed project price are defined in a written proposal.

additional.title: Additional development
additional.eligibility: For websites originally built by AI Studio by Olga. Have a website made by another developer or agency? AI Studio by Olga doesn't take over or modify it, but can build you a completely new website from scratch.

packages.name: Additional Development
packages.short: New pages, features or a fresh design for a website AI Studio by Olga built.
packages.best: Clients whose AI Studio by Olga website needs to grow beyond small monthly updates.
packages.limits: A one-time project with its own quote, not a monthly plan. Work starts only after you approve the quote. Available only for websites originally built by AI Studio by Olga.

care.title: Optional care

packages.name: Monitoring & checks
packages.short: Your site watched every month: uptime, SSL, domain and forms.
packages.best: Owners who want peace of mind and rarely need changes.
included: Monthly navigation and contact form checks
Routine technical checks and applicable updates
excluded: Hosting, domain, or third-party subscription fees
packages.limits: Month-to-month. Cancel any time, with no long-term commitment. Available only for websites built by AI Studio by Olga.

packages.name: Checks + small updates
packages.short: Everything in Essential Care, plus up to 60 minutes of small updates.
packages.best: Owners who change hours, prices, photos or text now and then.
included: Up to 60 minutes of small content updates per month
Updating contact information or business hours
excluded: More than 60 minutes of monthly updates
packages.limits: Unused update time does not roll over. Month-to-month; cancel any time, with no long-term commitment. Available only for websites built by AI Studio by Olga.

care.eligibility: Care plans are for websites built by AI Studio by Olga.

principles: Website development is a one-time project fee.
Clients retain their websites after canceling maintenance.
Ownership of agreed custom deliverables transfers after full payment, subject to third-party licenses.
Domain, hosting, software subscriptions, and AI API costs are disclosed before launch.
Additional work requires client approval before billing.
Each project has a clearly defined scope.
The 30-day bug-fix warranty covers defects in the agreed development work, not new features or third-party issues.

faq.q: Do I have to purchase maintenance?
faq.a: No. Maintenance is always optional, and your website works without it.
Yes. Ownership of the agreed custom work transfers to you after full payment, subject to any third-party licenses (fonts, plugins, stock images).
No. Domain, hosting and any software subscriptions are paid by you directly, and every cost is shown to you before launch.
Yes. Both care plans are month-to-month. There are no annual contracts, and you keep your website.

faq.q: What if I need more pages or features?
faq.a: That's Additional Development: a one-time, custom-quoted project for websites built by AI Studio by Olga. Nothing extra is billed without your approval first.

faq.q: Can you update or maintain a website someone else built?
faq.a: Not at this stage. AI Studio by Olga only maintains, modifies or redesigns websites it originally built. If your current website was made by another developer or agency, AI Studio by Olga can build you a completely new website from scratch.

faq.q: What happens if something breaks after launch?
faq.a: For 30 days, defects in the work I built are fixed free. After that, a care plan or a separate quote covers it. New features and third-party problems are not part of the warranty.

faq.q: Can I update the website myself?
faq.a: It depends on whether a CMS (a content management system, an editor for text and images) is included in your project. With a CMS, you can make everyday edits yourself. Without one, changes are made in the code, so you would ask me, or use Business Care for up to 60 minutes of small updates a month. Whether a CMS is included is agreed and written into your proposal before development begins.

faq.q: Are AI assistants included in the website packages?
faq.a: No. AI chatbots and automation are a separate service, quoted on their own.

faq.q: Will I know about recurring costs before launch?
faq.a: Yes. Domain, hosting, software and any AI API costs are listed before launch.
